name: radio
description: Exclusive labeled choices. Picking one unpicks the others.
avoidWhen: Do not use for independent on/off rows; use checkbox or switch. Do not use for peer panes; use tabs.

ux.behaviour: The filled radio is the current value
ux.why: You can see the choice without opening anything

ux.behaviour: Picking a row unpicks the others and fires a tick haptic
Each row is 48 dp and scales while pressed
ux.why: You tap the words, not a 20 dp circle

aiHints: Pass a stable id per option; do not use the label as the id if the label can change
Do not wrap each option in its own AppRadioGroup
